thread:
maria: Quick UX question — for automatic fallback (e.g., primary model -> cheaper/safer model on error or high latency), do we surface a visible undo/override in the console or keep it as an operational event only in audit logs?

devin: I lean visible + small undo. Operators need a fast recovery path when a fallback is noisy. :hand: 

alex: +1 for undo but scoped to canary / short TTL to avoid flip-flopping.

sienna: worried about accidental toggles. If we show undo, it should require a confirmation or be gated by role.

maria: Thinking of two UX modes: "transparent" (inline pill + undo CTA) and "audit-only" (console shows event but no direct undo). Also a lightweight banner on the route page when a fallback has recently happened.

devin: Could be a small pill in request logs: "auto-fallback (latency)" with a tiny 'view' link that opens an event detail. From there an operator can 'replay original' for the last minute.

ops-bot: NOTE: feature-flag rollout planned: fallback-ux-v1 -> 10% orgs starting 2024-05-01.

alex: For event reasons we need a structured schema: reason_code (e.g., MODEL_TIMEOUT, KV_OOM, POLICY_MISMATCH), human_label, original_model, fallback_model, decision_latency_ms. Display both label + hover for raw.

sienna: telemetry must capture: original response footprint, fallback response footprint, full sanitized error payload (truncated), and a decision_event_id that links to traces. Retention TBD.

maria: UX question: show truncated error message or map to friendly reason? e.g., "model-timeout" -> "Serving latency exceeded".

devin: Friendly label in UI, hover reveals raw (sanitized) payload with copy button. Keep the top-level UI digestible.

alex: Also propose an "undo window" of 60s for canary traffic and 15s for production by default. Undo should create a decision-event with actor metadata.

sienna: Audit requirements: who clicked undo, original decision_event_id, updated decision_event_id, timestamp, and justification text (optional). Must be immutable.

maria: My proposed UI mock: route detail shows compact toast: "Auto-fallback detected 2m ago — view details". The rollouts timeline shows an event row with reason, actor (system/operator), and a link to replay.

devin: Also need per-route config: opt-out of inline undo, and per-rollout override (enable for canary only).

ops-bot: REMINDER: add GDPR/data-scrub rules to fallback payloads before storing.

maria: Next steps / owners: I'll own UX mock + acceptance criteria; alex will own telemetry schema; devin will own console signal plumbing; sienna will draft audit retention policy.

alex: I'll open telemetry PR with schema and example event by EOD Thursday.

devin: I'll prototype the pill + event detail flow in the console sandbox next week.

sienna: I'll draft audit retention + privacy checklist.

maria: Great — I'll upload a mock tomorrow. If anyone has strong objections to inline undo, reply here, else we move forward with a two-mode option and short undo TTL. :ok_hand:
